notes.title: Lethal Honor Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that our brutal tale of conspiracy and cosmic horror, Lethal Honor: Order of the Apocalypse, will officially launch on [b]October 7th, 2025[/b].

Presented as a living graphic novel, Lethal Honor thrusts players into a clandestine war against eldritch horrors. The game’s dark narrative unfolds through gameplay, with each death revealing new clues to a horrifying mystery. Players must master fast-paced, punishing combat, combining a vast arsenal of abilities and artifacts to survive against overwhelming odds on the cursed Wolf Island.

The truth is waiting. The Order of the Apocalypse is recruiting. Add Lethal Honor to your Steam Wishlist today to be notified when the conspiracy goes live.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/

notes.title: QA's favorite ways to play [Electric Overkill]
notes.notes:
Hey, I’m Yona from QA and my favorite build in Lethal Honor is [b]Electric Overkill[/b]. It’s not named like that in the game, but you’ll see what I mean. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/1a74eab39d81d33ee4de35f75b96d59edeb9c25e.jpg[/img]


[table noborder=1]

    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/3d0ccac1e096ce57724d5d8a973d1337f6f3c0ae.png[/img][/td]
        [td]The central element of this build is definitely the[b] “Electric Coil”[/b] ability, which lets you place an electric coil every few seconds. When you place it, it will discharge a shock and connect with all other electric coils in the area. Now, those coils don’t do a lot by themselves, but they have a certain strength in numbers, so next we need a few more ways to place them around the battle areas.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]An easy way to do this is via the [b]“Trapper’s Kinetic Implant”[/b] artifact, which lets you drop a coil when dashing. It has a certain cooldown to it, but it’s enough to get an initial set of electric coils out at the beginning of each fight.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/34a1bb681cc953e4c65e874389a2c12bf13af5a0.png[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/6e3fbb067a4b25dc063bac5f322962b49bbdac60.png[/img][/td]
        [td]The most important element of the build is the artifact [b]“Security Bots”[/b], which makes it so enemies that were afflicted by Brittle will drop an electric coil when they die. Given that the shock ability of the coils will make enemies Brittle, this will almost always create another coil when enemies die to a shock chain.

To make the chaos complete, you can collect enchantments that will extend the lifetime of electric coils or make it so removing brittle from enemies will trigger other types of ailments or additional damage.
[/td]
    [/tr]

[/table]

Now, when playing this particular build, I usually refrain from using any regular attacks during combat and instead fully focus on placing more and more coils and then triggering chain reaction after chain reaction. It’s so satisfying to watch those shockwaves move between dozens of coils and killing everything that’s standing in between them.

However, if you want to go all out, you can also [b]imbue your weapon with the Brittle affix[/b] in a Crafting Node, which will then trigger the surrounding electric coils on every strike with your sword. But that’s a bit of an Overkill. See. I told you the name would make sense! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/8c3e734d17ed9767b17306e61a2964e0b2dffe2a.gif[/img]

Anyhow, try out this build for yourself or create your very own in our [b]Demo[/b], which is live now on Steam! There will be [b]even more possibilities once the full game releases! [/b]



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922460/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse_Demo/

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE – Localization, Steam Deck, Performance!
notes.notes:
Rejoice, Agents! 

We have prepared a big new patch for the Demo bringing additional language support, performance improvements, quality of life changes and plenty of bug fixes. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922460

[b]Localization  [/b]

In addition to the English and Japanese text support, we now added:
[list]
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]Chinese Simplified
[/list]
to the supported languages. Hopefully this will give even more aspiring Agents the chance of a first glimpse of the game. 



(Cautious) [b] Steam Deck Support   [/b]

While it is not perfect yet, the demo is now fully playable on Steam Deck! Some texts might be hard to make out on the small screen, but we are working on UI improvements to make everything easier to read for the full game.  



[b]Performance Improvements & Quality of Life  [/b]

The demo now runs a lot smoother and more stable than ever before. It is much more lightweight and doesn’t hog as much memory as before. This also reduces loading times by a lot! 

In addition to the performance improvements, we also implemented a bunch of quality-of-life features that make the game more enjoyable. Some of you found the auto-aim feature a little too much, so we tuned the default down a lot. You can still set auto-aim to high in the options or turn it off completely if it isn’t your cup of tea. 



[b]Bugfixes   [/b]

Thanks to everyone who took to the forums, Discord or e-mail to report problems they encountered while playing. We worked hard to fix a LOT of issues that were still in the demo. There should be a lot less random crashes, translation issues and all kinds of other problems that were still in the demo. Please continue sending in feedback and any issues you encounter so we can fix them for the main game.


That's all for now, have fun with the demo!

notes.title: Interview at Lethal Honor (pt.5)
notes.notes:
[code]
[h1] Top Secret Files Pt. 5 [/h1]

These excerpts of classified documents are detailing the catastrophic events at the Lethal Honor research facility on Wolf Island, which is rumored to have been overrun by demonic entities. This laboratory was tasked with creating the newest strain of Lethal Honor agents. The following first-hand account is expected to help shed some light on the incident. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/e7086048efdc28385185e4729e866984ef62bd2b.jpg[/img]
Interview conducted by [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler] and [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler], consecutively called Agent 1 and Agent 2.  
[hr][/hr]

[b]Agent 2[/b]: What do you mean by abilities? We haven’t talked about this yet.

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Some things we managed to learn from the demons and their spawn directly. The agents were able to use this knowledge to great effect. 

 
[b]Agent 1[/b]: Do you have an example how one of those abilities might look like?

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: They came in very different forms, from summoning companions to throwing fireballs. One agent managed to conjure a temporary black hole that decimated anything that got near the thing. Really scary stuff.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/a54fc81479e60ecb3e9c61ccbaddd44b2d60fa4d.gif[/img]

[b]Agent 2[/b]: This sounds insane. How did you manage to control these things?

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: We gladly managed to find [REDACTED] deeper in the laboratory and got her back to the Awakening Room safely. She was already experimenting with using the shadow to power the agent’s abilities before the outbreak. She was invaluable in helping us understand these skills.



[i]To be continued…  [/i]
[/code] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/

notes.title: Broadcasting: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse
notes.notes:
[b]Lethal Honor[/b] is part of the Steam Next Fest! To celebrate we are broadcasting on Friday - showing you the gameplay that awaits you in the demo and telling you about what is to come in the full release of the game.

So, make sure to jump in and learn more about this brutal roguelite and its obscure world ravaged by an apocalypse!

notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
In the early days of the Steam Next Fest, we have some nice updates and fixes for you.

Hope you like them, we'd love to hear your feedback! 



[b]New language available: Japanese! [/b]

[list]
[*]Apart from some smaller issues that we will update in the next days, you can now enjoy the demo in Japanese! 
[*]We are currently working on the localization of our other target languages German, Spanish and Chinese Simplified. 
[/list]

[b]New Crafting System! [/b]

[list]
[*]We have redesigned and implemented a new and improved crafting system.
[*]Each time you use the crafting table, you will receive 5 new but random affixes, which you can re-roll by investing Shadow or upgrading equipped attachments. 
 [/list]

[b]Combat gameplay assist [/b]

[list]
[*]As our mix of 2D and 3D combat is unique, but also unfamiliar to some players in terms of aiming, we have decided to turn on Melee Auto-Aim based on the feedback we got so far. Feel free to turn it off in the Options menu when you don’t like it. 
 [/list]

[b]New Main Menu Design [/b]

[list]
[*]We have redesigned the main menu to better reflect the unique style and feel of the game. 
  [/list]

[b]Various balance changes and bug fixes [/b]

[list]
[*]Players can now interact with items in the Recovery Room more than once. For example, you can restore two Regen Nanomachines. 

[*]Bosses and commanders won't target decoys. 

[*]Fixed an issue with players getting stuck at the crafting table. 

[*]Fixed the SFX and voice over sound lines of the Chainer Demon. 

[*]Improved the flow of the surrender scene. It is now faster and waits for the "Send Resources" window if there is one, and loads faster if there is not. 
  [/list]

notes.title: Interview at Lethal Honor (Pt.4)
notes.notes:
[code]
[h1] Top Secret Files Pt. 4 [/h1]

These excerpts of classified documents are detailing the catastrophic events at the Lethal Honor research facility on Wolf Island, which is rumored to have been overrun by demonic entities. This laboratory was tasked with creating the newest strain of Lethal Honor agents. The following first-hand account is expected to help shed some light on the incident. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/e7086048efdc28385185e4729e866984ef62bd2b.jpg[/img]
Interview conducted by [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler] and [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler], consecutively called Agent 1 and Agent 2.  
[hr][/hr]

[b]Agent 2[/b]: And for the agents themselves, how did they manage to survive this overwhelming assault?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: While roaming through the lab, the demons actually left a lot of useful things behind that the agents were able to use during their missions. See, demons get their power from connecting to their realm through something we called “Shadow”…

 
[b]Agent 1[/b]: Please, let’s keep to the point. 

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Ah yes, sorry. The demons sometimes left behind powerful Artifacts that granted our agents useful effects and helped us turn their own might against them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/e18f6fdfe292ae02a6229991dcf2538e5a8fb70e.png[/img]


[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Some of them were very powerful by themselves, providing useful offensive and defensive boons to the agent. Others were only working well in combination with other artifacts or abilities. Curious, it always felt like they had a mind of their own, as if they were seeking out their counterparts in this realm by their will.

[b]Agent 2[/b]: What do you mean by abilities? We haven’t heard about this yet. 




[i]To be continued…  [/i]
[/code] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/

notes.title: Interview at Lethal Honor (Pt. 3)
notes.notes:
[code]
[h1] Top Secret Files Pt. 3 [/h1]

These excerpts of classified documents are detailing the catastrophic events at the Lethal Honor research facility on Wolf Island, which is rumored to have been overrun by demonic entities. This laboratory was tasked with creating the newest strain of Lethal Honor agents. The following first-hand account is expected to help shed some light on the incident. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/e7086048efdc28385185e4729e866984ef62bd2b.jpg[/img]
Interview conducted by [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler] and [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler], consecutively called Agent 1 and Agent 2.  
[hr][/hr]

[b]Agent 2[/b]: What other tools did you have at your disposal to help the agents with their tasks?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: We were becoming a bit of a team over time, each one with different talents. Aida, of course, was the only one to fully understand the Cradle and all the systems within it. 

 
[b]Agent 1[/b]: The cradle?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: That’s the room where the agents were stored while their biological enhancement was still ongoing. It’s also the place where you would release them from their capsules when needed.

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/68f2ddef567cab5d005ef830e28df8f3d29afc4d.png[/img]

 

[b]Agent 2[/b]: And that’s all she did? Just wake up a bunch of agents?

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Not at all, Aida was brilliant, her knowledge went far beyond just using the systems that were in place. She also managed to make small on-the-fly adjustments that would help the agents in the short term after waking up. 

[b]Agent 2[/b]: I see, but the project was far from done, how did she manage to wake them up at all? 

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: As you know, none of the agents were finished. Most of them still needed months before their transformation would be fully complete. Aida managed to deal with that and even gave them some much-needed help on top.

[b]Agent 1[/b]: This must have taken a lot out of the system.

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: You are correct. This is where our Chief of Engineering came in. He might not have been the most likable person, but we were really glad to have found him alive. At the beginning, he got the basics running - oxygen, water, energy - but later, when our survival in the Awakening Room was secured, he managed to help the agents navigate the lab a lot better.


 [tr]
        [td]
[b]Agent 2[/b]: So, another altruistic helper like Aida?

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Haha, not in the slightest. He was solely interested in saving his own skin. But he was a smart man and he knew that there was no hope of getting out alive yet. So, he did what he did best and secured his escape route by studying the layout and finding some useful information for the agents.
[/td]

        [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/d1b6957e96472b0de26e959c19f55d84a791739c.png[/img]
[/td]
    [/tr]

[i]To be continued…  [/i]
[/code] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/

notes.title: Interview at Lethal Honor (Pt. 2)
notes.notes:
[code]
[h1] Top Secret Files Pt. 2 [/h1]

These excerpts of classified documents are detailing the catastrophic events at the Lethal Honor research facility on Wolf Island, which is rumored to have been overrun by demonic entities. This laboratory was tasked with creating the newest strain of Lethal Honor agents. The following first-hand account is expected to help shed some light on the incident. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/e7086048efdc28385185e4729e866984ef62bd2b.jpg[/img]
Interview conducted by [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler] and [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler], consecutively called Agent 1 and Agent 2.  
[hr][/hr]

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: They had built quite the base considering how torn apart everything looked. Aida Leone was the head of research at this laboratory and specialized in the mechanics of waking up their meticulously bioengineered agents. Quite the achievement for her young age.  

[b]Agent 2[/b]: So, Aida knew how to awaken the agents, but how did they make the Awakening Room habitable and functional with most of the machines and generators left in disrepair? 

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Aida somehow found [spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler], our chief of engineering, inside the demon infested lab and managed to get him to the Awakening Room with the help of an agent. He was the key to getting oxygen and power flowing again.  

 
[b]Agent 1[/b]: Regarding the agents. How did they defend themselves?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: There were plenty of weapons specifically designed for the agents. Some were still prototypes, whereas others were already functional.  

There was the katana - balanced and nimble. VERY good at slicing through nasties of all kinds.  

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/5b4db6a1fdc61a38e4df0c1b02f26d532fb70f6e.gif[/img]

 

For the more agile types, there were also the katar, fist mounted twin-blades designed to get in and out of combat at a staggering pace.  

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/cd90496d3f376dfd18d04f9d8a37533eacaf1863.gif[/img]

 

The hammer was insanely hefty, but some of the agents could handle it to a devastating effect.  

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/706d4c0a5e0c50272e84d6d149f27cb60d1e9dc9.gif[/img]

 

[b]Agent 2[/b]: I think that’s enough of the weapons for now. It must have been impossible to get through all the horrors around you with just plain weapons. What other tools did you have at your disposal to help the agents get through their tasks?  


[i]To be continued…  [/i]
[/code] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/

notes.title: Interview at Lethal Honor (Pt. 1)
notes.notes:
[code]
[h1] Top Secret Files Pt. 1 [/h1]

These excerpts of classified documents are detailing the catastrophic events at the Lethal Honor research facility on Wolf Island, which is rumored to have been overrun by demonic entities. This laboratory was tasked with creating the newest strain of Lethal Honor agents. The following first-hand account is expected to help shed some light on the incident. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/e7086048efdc28385185e4729e866984ef62bd2b.jpg[/img]
Interview conducted by [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler] and [spoiler] [REDACTED] [/spoiler], consecutively called Agent 1 and Agent 2.  
[hr][/hr]
[b]Agent 1[/b]: We have some questions for you regarding the events on [spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler].   

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: I’ll do my best to tell you all I know.  


[b]Agent 1[/b]: How did it all start?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: It began at [spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]. Suddenly, there were demons and their spawn prowling through the lab and infesting every corner. Naturally, I tried to find cover and started documenting everything.  


[b]Agent 2[/b]: You started documenting? Why didn’t you try to flee?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: It was frightening but it piqued my curiosity as a researcher. I have conducted studies on the paranormal long before these events unfolded. This was my chance to get some hands-on experience!  


[b]Agent 1[/b]: And what did you find?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: There was one demon who seemed to be in charge of leading the others. Quite fascinating. He was intelligent, frighteningly so.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/a0ba0327d19f6731282f2598bd57654fbff7d3cb.gif[/img]


[b]Agent 2[/b]: And how did you manage to get out of the laboratory?  

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: Since I saw so many lifeless bodies around, I thought that everyone was gone for good, so I didn’t put much effort into finding anyone else. To my surprise, they eventually found me and took me with them to their base of operations – the Awakening Room. 
 [tr]
        [td]
[b]Agent 1[/b]: Who were they?

[spoiler] [b][REDACTED][/b][/spoiler]: A few of my former colleagues managed to hole up together. Leading them was Aida Leone who was using the agents to save as many people as possible.  

Many died and waking new agents was the only chance at survival we had. I think that Aida was even hopeful enough back then to think we could stop whatever was happening.  
[/td]

        [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901857/f367604bc21c3c45beeb85a1427e795854446ef2.png[/img]
[/td]
    [/tr]
[i] To be continued…  [/i]
[/code] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/
